sprite.description: Its emoji or placeholder; a skin draws it by id.

reach.description: How it fights, for a client drawing a unit it has no art for (decision 0052). No rule reads it.

physPen.description: Flat penetration of its Physical hits: points of the target's PHYS RES they ignore (decision 0095). 0 when left out.

magPen.description: Flat penetration of its Magic hits: points of the target's MAG RES they ignore (decision 0095). 0 when left out.

physPierce.description: Percentage penetration of its Physical hits: whole percentage points of the target's PHYS RES they ignore, before flat penetration (decision 0095). 0 when left out.

magPierce.description: Percentage penetration of its Magic hits: whole percentage points of the target's MAG RES they ignore, before flat penetration (decision 0095). 0 when left out.

tags.description: What else it is, beside its class, such as bruiser (decision 0100). Labels for a client; no rule reads them. None when left out.

characterGroup.description: The set of heroes it belongs to, such as Gods of Olympus (decision 0054). A title for a client; no rule reads it.

class.description: What job it does in a line-up, such as Guardian or Support (decision 0054). A label for a client and what the bot's pick spreads on; no rule reads it.

ai.description: The enemy AI; default when unset. A healer needs a skill with special heal, a charger chargeEvery and one charge and one release skill.

aim.description: Whom its attacks aim at (decision 0103); random when unset. front: the foremost line of the side it attacks; back: its rearmost line; weakest: the lowest HP. A side with no formation is one line, so front and back are anyone there. Cover still applies to the hit afterwards.

stands.description: Where it stands when summoned onto a side in a formation (decision 0103), unless the summon effect says: the first line, the last, or its summoner's own. The back when neither says.

shields.description: When summoned, it shields those behind it (decision 0103), unless the summon effect says. False when neither says.

covered.description: When summoned, it takes its line's cover (decision 0103), unless the summon effect says. False when neither says.

chargeEvery.description: A charger winds up every this many actions; only a charger has it.

skills.description: Its own skills, written in full; at least one with no special, for its regular turns.
